entries.zh: 该物种进化出由金属合金构成的组织，能在传统有机体会被烧煮的高温行星上繁衍生息。这些合金细胞退化速度慢，更换频率低，延缓了与年龄相关疾病的发生。但此类细胞还会传导低温，使该物种在寒冷气候中易受威胁。
entries.en: This species evolved tissues of metallic alloys to grow and thrive on hot planets where traditional organics would cook. These alloyed cells are slower to degrade and are replaced infrequently, delaying the onset of age-related diseases. They also conduct cold temperatures, which can threaten their health in colder climates.

entries.en: Bound by an intricate web of mirror neurons, these individuals possess an innate ability to synchronize their will. Duty is not a burden, but a shared purpose, and hardship is met with unwavering unity.

entries.en: An intricate symbiosis with $r_living_metal$ allows this species to grow not in the traditional sense, but through the accretion and self-assembly of bio-ferrous structures.

entries.en: An intricate integration of $r_living_metal$ allows this machine species to expand not through conventional construction, but via the accretion and self-assembly of auto-ferrous frameworks.

entries.zh: 这一物种诞生于火山星球的炽烈炼狱，早已习惯与灾难为伴。他们不惧那席卷大地的熔岩碎屑流，反而学会驯服与引导其狂怒，将毁灭之力淬炼为生机与能量的源泉。
entries.en: Shaped by the relentless fury of volcanic worlds, this species does not fear pyroclastic forces - they channel and manipulate them, transforming devastation into a vital source of sustenance and power.

entries.zh: 该物种经过逆境锤炼并以共同奋斗为纽带，成为坚不可摧的整体。集体意志推动治理，每个成员是链条中的关键环节。
entries.en: Tempered by adversity and bound by shared struggle, this species has been forged into an unbreakable whole. Their collective will fuels governance, each member a vital link in the chain of unity.

entries.zh: 岩石圈仍处于半熔融状态，硫磺浓重的大气笼罩其上。地表布满火山灰与玄武岩，活火山频繁喷发，熔岩湖与熔岩河纵横交错。若有生命存在，也只能是极端环境下的幸存者。
entries.en: Rocky world with a sulfur rich atmosphere and a partially liquid lithosphere. The ash and basalt covered surface is interspersed with fresh volcanic activity, lava lakes and rivers. Only extremophile life forms can be found, if any.

entries.zh: 地热发电厂利用行星内部翻滚的热能为殖民地提供能源。
entries.en: Exploits the churning heat deep inside the planet to provide power to the colony.

entries.zh: 一系列电磁筛网从行星的岩浆流中提取珍贵矿物。
entries.en: A series of electromagnetic sieves extracts valuable minerals from the planet's magma flows.

entries.zh: 这个跨学科的协作与教育中心帮助殖民地管理行星的地质活力。
entries.en: This hub of interdisciplinary collaboration and education helps the colony manage the geological dynamism of the planet.

entries.zh: 习惯于极端高温的工人，擅长将矿物合成有用的新合金。
entries.en: Habituated to extreme heat, this worker is skilled in combining minerals into useful new alloys.

entries.zh: 为承受极端高温而制造，此子个体经过专门设计，用来将矿物合成有用的新合金。
entries.en: Built to withstand extreme heat, this drone is designed to combine minerals into useful new alloys.

entries.zh: 拥有多样技能背景，导师帮助弥合学科间的差距，提高专业工人的工作效率。
entries.en: With a diverse background of skills, this mentor helps bridge disciplinary gaps to boost the efficiency of specialized workers.

entries.zh: 这个文明正站在命运的十字路口：其恒星系中央的红巨星正在持续升温，炙烤着他们的家园。\n\n在找到原因并解决之前，他们是否能适应这恶劣的环境？或选择拥抱这股炙热之力，将那诡异、甚至可能不自然的变化化为己用？
entries.en: This civilization is at a crossroads: the Red Giant at the heart of its system is warming up their planet, threatening to cook them alive.\n\nCan they adapt until the cause is found and fixed, or will they decide to embrace the heat, capitalizing on these strange and perhaps unnatural changes?

entries.zh:
真相来得缓慢，却又骤然明了。

我们的恒星正进入一个快速且异常的演变阶段。其能量输出已超出所有预期参数。光谱转变显示异常对流模式，其核聚变速率似乎在无相应质量损失情况下提升。

迄今为止，我们与这股升温同步演化。但基础生物进化有其极限。

若[capital_star.GetName]内正在进行的变化持续，母星将被焚毁。问题不再是“是否”，而是“何时”。
entries.en:
The truth came slowly, then all at once.

Our star is entering a phase of rapid and anomalous evolution. Its energy output has climbed beyond all expected parameters. Spectral shifts indicate erratic convection patterns, and its fusion rate appears to be increasing without a corresponding loss of mass.

So far, we have evolved in concert with this warming. But basic biological evolution has its limits.

If the changes underway within [capital_star.GetName] continue, the world we call home will burn. It is no longer a question of if, but when.

entries.zh: 这是帝国使用§Y$origin_red_giant$§!起源默认的初始恒星系。
entries.en: This is the guaranteed starting system for empires using the §Y$origin_red_giant$§! Origin.

entries.zh: 如同任何潜在危害，我们恒星转变产生的危险辐射也能成为武器。将其引导为束能武器，可使敌舰过热瘫痪。\n\n解锁殖民地决议，在轨道上建造§Y$starfire_cannon$§!。
entries.en: Like any potential hazard, the dangerous radiation from our star's transformation can also be harnessed as a useful tool. Channeling it as a beam weapon would allow us to overheat and disable enemy ships. \n\nUnlocks a Colony Decision to construct a §Y$starfire_cannon$§! in orbit.

entries.zh: 一束强大的能量束，可穿透最强防御，瘫痪脆弱舰船系统。
entries.en: A powerful beam of energy that can pierce even the strongest defenses and disable vulnerable ship systems.

entries.zh: §Y令目标§!瘫痪§G5§!日，降低其速度、射速和护盾。
entries.en: §YDisables§! the target for §G5§! days, reducing its speed, fire rate and shields.

entries.zh: 模拟迅速老化红巨星的强烈辐射，该轨道炮发射高温电离束，不仅能损伤目标，还会烧毁舰船组件使其失效。
entries.en: Mimicking the intense radiation of a rapidly aging red giant star, this orbital cannon projects a beam of hyperthermal ionization that not only damages its targets but also fries ship components to render them inoperable.

entries.zh: 在行星轨道建造§Y$starfire_cannon$§!，一款远程武器，可瘫痪多舰船系统。
entries.en: Builds a §Y$starfire_cannon$§! in the planet's orbit, a long-ranged weapon that can disable the systems of multiple ships.

entries.zh: 这不是一个崛起的文明，而是一个被释放的文明。当休眠仓开启，他们醒来时，早已物换星移，故土难寻。但他们的过去并未湮灭，而是埋藏在星系尘土与废墟之下，静候再次被发掘。
entries.en: This civilization did not rise; it was released. As the stasis pods unlocked, they awakened to a world aged beyond recognition. Yet all is not lost. Scattered beneath dust and ruin across the galaxy, their past endures, waiting to be rediscovered.

entries.zh: —$HOMEWORLD$$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—['concept_pc_volcanic']（规模：£planetsize£14）$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—['concept_inf_cd_deposit']：+5\n—以事件状态开始：§H深度开采§!

我们苏醒之时，只能依稀感知自己曾经沉眠。即便如今，我们对往昔最确凿的证据，也并非记忆本身，而是那保存休眠躯体的庞大而精密的科技体系。

成千上万的休眠舱，贯穿地下的传热系统，翻腾不息的熔岩之炉。墙壁上刻满了我们的起源痕迹：舰队自逐渐冷却的母星启程，奔赴群星之间，追寻新的温暖。为了寻找真相，我们离开了这座地下“孵化室”。在§Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§!的地表，我们找到了可用的科技与资源，也在行星地壳深处探测到更多隐藏的设施。我们的同族或许正在其中一些设施中安眠。

那群星呢？是否在遥远的虚空中，还有如我们一般沉睡的族群？若真如此，也许他们能助我们解开那个自觉醒起便萦绕心头的疑问——我们是谁？
entries.en:
We woke with only the faintest sense that we had ever fallen asleep. Even now, our strongest evidence of a time before comes not from our own memories, but from the complex technology that preserved us in stasis.

Thousands upon thousands of pods, massive heat-transfer systems, cauldrons churning molten rock. Beyond these bare mechanisms, clues to our origin were inscribed in the walls: fleets of ships, scattering from cooling worlds to seek warmth among the stars. In search of answers, we left this underground 'birthing chamber.' Across the surface of §Y[owner.Capital.GetName]§! we discovered useful technology and resources. We have also found evidence of further facilities nestled within the planet's crust. Some hold sleepers we might welcome as kin.

And what of the stars? Are there others like us, still sleeping? If they exist, perhaps they can help us answer our most burning question: who are we?

entries.zh: 这是使用$origin_cosmic_dawn$起源默认的初始恒星系。
entries.en: This is the guaranteed starting system when using the $origin_cosmic_dawn$ Origin.

entries.zh: 这些休眠仓为失落亲族的远古设备，利用先进低温技术使个体暂停生命体征。借助特定科技或许能唤醒他们。
entries.en: These stasis pods are ancient devices from our lost kin, using advanced cryogenic technology to keep individuals in suspended animation. With the right technology, we may be able to awaken them.

entries.zh: 曾用以存放一排排休眠室，这些空旷而广阔的隧道如今提供了新居住空间。
entries.en: Once used to store rows of stasis chambers, these now empty but vast tunnels provide new living space.

entries.zh: 一些$r_living_metal$矿藏。与这种令人惊叹的资源接触的物种会沿着独特的生物和科学路径持续发展演变。
entries.en: A$r_living_metal$ deposit. Species evolving in constant contact with this fascinating resource, are set on unique biological and scientific trajectories.

entries.zh: 热量渗透社会文化各方面，从传统礼仪到科技。他们视自身为星系之中的真正火焰霸主，向往仅适合嗜热生命存活的理想宇宙，而弱者只会拖累这一愿景的达成。
entries.en: Heat permeates every facet of this society's culture, from traditions and rituals to technology itself. They see themselves as the galaxy's rightful fiery supremacists, viewing weaker species as mere obstacles on the path to an ideal universe, fit only for Thermophiles.

entries.en: This society thrives in volcanic environments, and will even create them artificially when nature falls short.

entries.en: Forged by generations of extreme hardship, this society believes in survival through unity, and unity through survival. Only fire-born struggle can bind them tightly enough to endure a cold, uncaring galaxy.

entries.zh: 火焰舞者是火焰与耐力的大师，表演灼烈仪式，令社区共享敬畏与激情。
entries.en: Masters of flame and endurance, Fire Dancers perform searing rites that bind the community in awe and shared fervor.

entries.zh: 火葬者掌控圣火仪式，引导逝者穿过火焰迈向终极奥秘。被尊为此崇高通道的守护者，服务于死亡与超脱的交界。
entries.en: Cremators oversee the sacred rite of flame, guiding the departed through fire to their final mystery. Honored as custodians of this revered passage, they serve where death meets transcendence.

entries.zh: 火焰肆虐后的混乱只余焦炭与灰烬，而技艺高超的先知能从其中辨识符号。那些秘奥般的解读被奉为仪式核心，也成为统治的凭依。
entries.en: The destructive chaos of fire still leaves behind signs in char and ash that a skilled seer can interpret. These esoteric insights are put to use in ritual and rule alike.

entries.zh: 历经多年磨炼，能透过火焰波动洞察未来倾向，其中技艺熟练者可换取统治精英的赞助。
entries.en: After spending years honing their ability to spot ripples of the future in the flickering of flames, skilled practitioners of the art exchange their skills for patronage by the ruling elite.

entries.zh: 引领民众安然度过最黑暗时刻的预言家，倡导面对死亡时的忍耐与生存美德。
entries.en: A visionary to guide the people safely through the darkest times, promoting virtues of endurance and survival in the face of death.

entries.zh: 领袖于仪式灰烬中解读神秘符号的技巧，以及激发心底命运之火的能力，可提升政治工作水平。
entries.en: The work of politics is bolstered by a leader's skill in reading occult signs in ritual ash, and invoking the will of the deep fires of fate.

entries.zh: 为保持信仰之火燃烧，掌控社会的祭司阶层展现神圣火焰光芒，照亮追随者之路，净化社会邪恶。
entries.en: To keep burning the flames of faith, this society's ruling priesthood embodies the radiant light of holy fire, lighting the way for their followers and cleansing evil from society.

entries.zh: 作为维护体制根基的精英，火焰贵族如生生不息的火焰一般统治国家，依靠劳工的奉献维系荣耀。
entries.en: An entrenched elite whose brilliance defines the state, Pyrocrats rule as living flames and are sustained by the labor of those who stoke their glory.

entries.zh: 火焰燃尽处，灰烬经纪人兴盛。这些废墟之上的投机者善于将毁灭转化为机遇，将灰烬化为资产。
entries.en: Where fire consumes, Ashbrokers thrive. These profiteers of ruin are skilled in turning devastation into opportunity and ashes into assets.

entries.zh: 被尊为预见者与领袖，这些预兆者融合信仰与权威，以圣火引领帝国迈向命运注定的辉煌。
entries.en: Revered as both visionaries and leaders, these harbingers unite faith and authority. Through sacred flame, they guide the empire toward its destined radiance.

entries.zh: 锻造于火山熔炉，经历困苦淬炼，此军团以无情决心战斗。
entries.en: Forged in volcanic crucibles and tempered by deprivation, this legion fights with pitiless resolve.

entries.zh: 是时候真正拥抱火焰，检验我们的勇气了。在整个行星燃起火焰！
entries.en: It is time for us to truly embrace the flames and test our mettle. Set the whole planet on fire!

entries.en: The only way to attain divine unity is to survive the hardest of crucibles.\n\n§LSpiritualist Ethos§!

entries.en: Their members promote spiritualist values, praising hardship and the ability to suffer through it. Physical trials play a significant role in their society.\n\n

entries.en: As a result of bringing this faction into their government, they have become more outwardly §HSpiritualist§!.\n\n

entries.zh: 当殖民行星中至少有50%为火山时，[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is pleased when at least 50% of colonized planets are Volcanic in nature.

entries.zh: 启用移民控制或强制迁移时，[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] will be pleased if Migration Controls or Forced Resettlement are enabled.

entries.zh: 当至少有一颗行星宜居性低于20%作为示范时，[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] appreciates having at least one planet under 20% habitability to lead by example.

entries.zh: 当炽焰灾祸最近发生时，[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is pleased when the Blazing Scourge has been deployed recently.

entries.zh: 当努力让更多行星火山化时，[Root.GetName]感到满意。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] is pleased when efforts are undertaken to make more planets Volcanic.

entries.zh: 填补炽焰祭司内阁席位将令[Root.GetName]满意。
entries.en: Filling the Pyromanic Priest council position will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 帝国中拥有1000名火焰舞者将令[Root.GetName]满意。
entries.en: Having 1000 Fire Dancers in the empire will please the [Root.GetName].

entries.en: These units have self-repairing frames made of special alloys that combine the benefits of biology and artificial intelligence.

entries.zh: 由造船厂锻造成形，此$r_living_metal$装甲在遭受重大损伤后将回复至原始状态。
entries.en: Cured into shape by shipyard forges, this $r_living_metal$ armor will regrow into its original form after suffering major damage.

entries.zh: 加厚$r_living_metal$能提升其基础防御效用和可再生表面积。
entries.en: Thickening the $r_living_metal$ improves both its baseline defensive utility, and its surface area available for regenerating.

entries.zh: 提升$r_living_metal$抗拉强度的复合材料使装甲更坚韧。
entries.en: Composites that improve the tensile strength of $r_living_metal$ allow this armor to be stronger and more resilient.

entries.zh: 高能固化工艺令此再生$r_living_metal$装甲结构比前代更稳固。
entries.en: High-energy curing processes allow this regenerative $r_living_metal$ armor to be more structurally sound than its predecessors.

entries.zh: $r_living_metal$科学的进步使此装甲的强度与再生能力达到物理极限。
entries.en: Advances in $r_living_metal$ sciences makes this armor as strong and as regenerative as physics allows.

entries.zh: 舰体表面形成厚重防护鳞片，受损后可完全再生。
entries.en: The body of the ship forms thick defensive scales which can be fully regrown after injury.

entries.zh: 改良的$r_living_metal$代谢提高了装甲的再生能力。
entries.en: Improved metabolism of $r_living_metal$ has increased the regenerative capabilities of this armor.

entries.zh: 自增强几何形态中生长的铁皮质进一步提升装甲防御效用。
entries.en: Ferrodermis grown in self-reinforcing geometry further improve the armor's defensive utility.

entries.zh: 铁皮质周围的组织分化实现防御与再生的专门化，提升二者效果。
entries.en: Tissue differentiation around the ferroderms allows for specialization in defense and regeneration, improving the efficacy of both.

entries.zh: $r_living_metal$先进的生物复合材质使其成为可生长的最强防护装甲。
entries.en: Advanced biological composites of $r_living_metal$ make this the most powerful defensive armor that can be grown.

entries.en: Powerful centrifuges help partition liquid alloys such that they can be recomposed into $r_living_metal$.

entries.zh: 分子级使用$r_living_metal$促进生成更有效的模块化化合物，进而加强生长。
entries.en: Molecular use of $r_living_metal$ allows for effective modular compounds that promote stronger growth.

entries.zh: 用$r_living_metal$制造的火炮能在磨损后自行再生，并重新塑形以优化物理特性，以便使用更强弹药。
entries.en: Artillery built with $r_living_metal$ is able to regenerate from wear and tear on its own, and re-mold itself to optimize its physical properties, allowing more potent ammunition to be used.

entries.zh: 该诊所向当地居民出售性能增强的$r_living_metal$化合物，带来利润和有用副产品。
entries.en: This clinic sells a performance enhancing $r_living_metal$ compound to the local population, generating profit and useful byproducts.

entries.zh: 该中心协调前往邻近熔融星球的自由远征队，探险者可在那里发现珍贵的$r_volatile_motes$和$r_living_metal$。
entries.en: This center coordinates freelance expeditions to a nearby Molten World, where enterprising prospectors may uncover valuable $r_volatile_motes$ and $r_living_metal$.

entries.zh: 勇于冒险的寻宝者前往熔融星球寻找$r_volatile_motes$和$r_living_metal$。
entries.en: Enterprising prospectors travel offworld to hunt for $r_volatile_motes$ and $r_living_metal$ on Molten Worlds.

entries.zh: 远程子个体被部署到邻近熔融星球，勘探并采集$r_volatile_motes$和$r_living_metal$。
entries.en: Long-range drones are deployed to nearby Molten Worlds to identify and harvest $r_volatile_motes$ and $r_living_metal$.

entries.zh: $TITLE$激励武装力量，确保各方对军事行动全力投入。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ fires up the armed forces, maintaining commitment to military efforts.

entries.zh: $TITLE$可解决极热环境下基础设施建设的技术难题。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ can solve the technical challenges encountered when constructing infrastructure in an exceptionally hot environment.

entries.zh: 支付适当报酬后，$TITLE$可解决极热环境下的建设技术难题。
entries.en: For the right payment, a $TITLE$ can solve the technical challenges encountered when constructing infrastructure in an exceptionally hot environment.

entries.zh: $TITLE$激发对艰难环境的热爱，减少奢侈消费。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ instills a love of hardship, reducing decadent consumption.

entries.zh: $TITLE$利用动态固体专业知识协助物理与工程研究。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ leverages an expertise in dynamic solids to assist in physics and engineering research.

entries.zh: $TITLE$利用动态固体专业知识协助物理与工程研究。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ leverages an expertise in dynamic solids to assist in physics and engineering research.

entries.zh: $TITLE$协调各方利益，促进物理与工程研究。
entries.en: The $TITLE$ coordinates between stakeholders to facilitate physics and engineering research.

entries.zh: 火风暴的轰炸点燃了行星的部分区域，宛如壮丽篝火，既强化我们的决心，也凝聚了社会。
entries.en: Firestorm bombardment sets parts of the planet on fire, serving as a glorious bonfire that strengthens our resolve and unifies our society.

entries.zh: $bombardment_seismic_bombing$针对行星地质，摧毁基础设施并撕裂地壳，引发大规模火山爆发。
entries.en: $bombardment_seismic_bombing$ targets the planet's geology, destroying infrastructure and splitting the crust to bring forth massive volcanoes.

entries.zh: 允许全面使用轨道武器，旨在毁坏地表。\n\n§E开启“毁灭”轨道轰炸姿态。§!
entries.en: Allows the full use of all orbital weaponry, with the express aim of devastating the landscape.\n\n§EAllows 'Devastation' orbital bombardment stance.§!

entries.zh: 此帝国致力于彻底毁灭外星行星。
entries.en: This empire seeks to thoroughly devastate alien planets.

entries.zh: 以火焰扫荡星系系。任何阻力一律视为攻击目标。
entries.en: War is waged to scour the galaxy with fire. Any opposition is a fair target.

entries.zh: $personality_scorching_infernals$视异星星球为进行灾难性火焰仪式的绝佳场所，当地土著不过是微小的麻烦。
entries.en: $personality_scorching_infernals$ see alien worlds as excellent places to conduct catastrophic fire rituals. Local sentients are a minor inconvenience to them.

entries.zh: 新冷却的火山矿脉提供丰富的矿石资源。
entries.en: Freshly-cooled volcanic veins provide a rich source of ores.

entries.zh: 古老的地质活动将这层丰富的矿物深埋于地表之下。
entries.en: Ancient geological activity left this rich layer of minerals buried far below the surface.

entries.zh: 下方的构造板块被以往的火山喷发碾碎，使得钻探矿脉变得更加容易。
entries.en: The underlying tectonic plates have been crushed by previous eruptions, making it much easier to drill to mineral-rich veins.

entries.zh: 远处隐约闪烁的光芒揭示出这些丘陵表层下蕴藏的矿石财富。
entries.en: Faint glinting from afar gives away the wealth of ores just below the surface of these hills.

entries.zh: 自由流动的岩浆发出温暖的红色光芒，冲刷着熔岩河的河岸。
entries.en: The warm, reddish glow of free-flowing magma bathes the shores of these lava rivers.

entries.zh: 这些高原在地质上相较周围区域更加稳定。
entries.en: These plateaus are geologically stable compared to the surrounding area.

entries.zh: 这片缓缓起伏的平原大多未受行星范围混乱的影响。
entries.en: These gently rolling flatlands lie mostly untouched by wider planetary chaos.

entries.zh: 远离任何断层线，此区域不受地质灾害的影响。
entries.en: Far from any fault lines, this region is protected against geological devastation.

entries.zh: 一片闪亮的玄武岩高原，古老火山力量使其出现裂纹和凹坑。
entries.en: A gleaming plateau of solidified basalt, cracked and pitted by ancient volcanic forces.

entries.zh: 持续流动的熔岩释放出独特混合的化学物质至其上方空气中。
entries.en: This persistent lava flow exudes a peculiar mixture of chemicals into the air above it.

entries.zh: 一条古老的熔岩河早已冷却，仅留炭黑色的痕迹横贯大地。
entries.en: An ancient lava river cooled off long ago, leaving only a charred streak through the land.

entries.zh: 长而空旷的隧道穿行山体，墙壁被古老岩浆流灼烧并磨平。
entries.en: Long, hollow tunnels wind through the mountain, their walls scorched and smoothed by ancient magma flows.

entries.zh: 这些张开的通风口从行星深处喷出热的$exotic_gases$。
entries.en: These gaping vents exhale hot, $exotic_gases$ from the planet's depths.

entries.zh: 火山灰笼罩大气，使星球陷入闷热且灰尘弥漫的暮色中。
entries.en: Volcanic ash smothers the atmosphere, casting the world into a stifling, ash-choked twilight.

entries.zh: 由火山灰形成的黑暗肥沃土壤提供了难得的作物种植机会。
entries.en: Dark, nutrient-rich soil formed by volcanic ash provides a rare opportunity to grow crops.

entries.zh: 该区域因地震地毯轰炸而裂开，形成活跃火山活动。
entries.en: This region has been split open into active volcanism by seismic carpet bombing.

entries.zh: 此区域被呛人的火山灰云层包围。
entries.en: This region is swaddled in clouds of choking ash.

entries.zh: 区域空气充满危险且刺激的电能。
entries.en: The air in this region sparks with dangerous and stimulating energies.

entries.zh: 该区域会发生季节性的炽热熔岩洪水。
entries.en: This region is exhibits seasonal floods of scorching lava.

entries.zh: 此地大气几乎不可呼吸，仅有最强者能存活。
entries.en: This region's atmosphere is barely breathable, allowing only the strongest to survive.

entries.zh: 倾泻的熔岩瀑布壮观无比，逐级倾斜而下。
entries.en: These torrential falls of molten lava are a sight to behold as they cascade through the landscape.

entries.zh: 广阔地区持续遭受构造活动和火山喷发蹂躏。
entries.en: A widespread area constantly ravaged by tectonic activity and erupting volcanos.

entries.zh: 即使在炎热致命的熔岩星球中，生命仍能找到出路。
entries.en: Even in a world of extreme heat and deadly lava, life finds a way.

entries.zh: 巨大的晶体带着热量和温暖的光芒，震颤着从熔岩池中缓缓升起。
entries.en: Vast crystals thrumming with heat and warm light slowly rise from this pool of lava.

entries.zh: 地表之下藏有庞大洞穴，空洞回响见证着火焰塑造行星的历史。
entries.en: Beneath the surface, immense caverns remain, hollow echoes of a planet shaped by fire.

entries.zh: 此处熔岩自由流动，倾泻下陡坡，形成天然的烟火表演。
entries.en: Lava flows freely here, spilling over a steep incline in a natural pyrotechnic display.

entries.zh: 一片小小的翠绿大陆，在高山保护中躲过了烈焰肆虐。独特的动植物与山外荒芜形成鲜明对比。
entries.en: A small and green continent, protected by a high mountain range from the raging inferno beyond. The unique flora and fauna stand in stark contrast to the desolation that lies just beyond the mountains.

entries.zh: 探测器发现一奇异物体在小行星带中漂移。其来源未知，但轨迹稳定，表明可拦截检查。
entries.en: Sensors have picked up a strange object drifting through the asteroid field. Its origin is unknown, but its course is steady, suggesting it can be intercepted and examined.

entries.zh:
[Leader.GetName]报告发现一个有棱角的刚性结构体悬浮于恒星稳定轨道中。该结构体由未知材料组成，表面具有类似晶体结构的棱面，成分无法分析。它保持固定方向，始终面向其恒星，抵抗所有外力操控或旋转。

在一项受控实验中，调查船对该结构体发射集束脉冲，致其整齐裂开，分裂成两个对称半体，每个半体又各自重构为原结构体的小型复制体。后续脉冲产生相同效果：分裂、复制及稳定微缩。

最后，众多微型结构体分散形成一片云，稳定漂浮于轨道上。每一块碎片都保留了原结构体的精确排列与几何特征，整体则还原了原始结构轮廓。

此现象前所未有且无法解释。所有数据均已归档，待深入分析。
entries.en:
[Leader.GetName] reported the discovery of a rigid, angular construct suspended in stable stellar orbit. Composed of an unknown material and marked by faceted planes reminiscent of crystalline structures, the object resisted all compositional analysis. It remained locked in a fixed orientation, perpetually facing its parent star, and withstood all attempts at manipulation or rotation.

During a controlled experiment, the survey vessel subjected the object to a concentrated energy pulse. The construct fractured cleanly, splitting into two symmetrical halves, each of which reconfigured into a smaller replica of the original. Subsequent pulses produced identical outcomes: division, replication, and consistent miniaturization.

Eventually, a diffuse cloud of miniature constructs stabilized in orbit. Each fragment retained the precise alignment and geometry of the progenitor, and the swarm as a whole mirrored the original structure's silhouette.

The phenomenon remains entirely without precedent or explanation. All collected telemetry has been archived for further analysis.

entries.zh: [Planet.GetName]表面炙热，不适宜生物生存。行星上明显的人工遗迹影像引起了[GetScientistPlural]的注意。考古调查或可揭示这里的居民和曾发生在他们身上的故事。
entries.en: The surface of [Planet.GetName] is scorching hot, and hostile to biological life. Images of clearly artificial ruins have therefore caught the attention of [GetScientistPlural]. An archaeological investigation could reveal who was here, and what happened to them.

entries.zh: [From.Planet.GetName]遗迹初看似由石头构成，但挖掘和分析表明，许多建筑由石化的类木材有机物构成。现今行星上已无该材料来源。小型文物由粗制金属、玻璃及类似的石化有机物组成，[GetScientistPlural]还发现了已灭绝本土生物的化石。\n\n该文明疑居于气候温和时期。他们是早已消失，还是目睹了巨变的尾声？
entries.en: While the ruins on [From.Planet.GetName] first appeared to be built of stone, excavation and analysis suggests that many of the structures in this lost city are made of a petrified organic material comparable to wood. No source for such materials exists on the planet today. Smaller artifacts are built of crude metals, glass, and similar petrified organics, and [GetScientistPlural] have also found fossils of native creatures that no longer exist. \n\nIt appears the civilization in question inhabited the planet at a time when its climate was much more temperate. Did they disappear long before the planet turned to its current state, or did they witness the violent transition in their final years?

entries.zh: 在[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟中挖掘出若干具有文化价值的场所，墙面饰有复杂纹样，疑为某种文字。最激动人心的是，挖掘队发现一个密布书架的地下房间，摆满刻有繁复铭文的青铜薄板。青铜作为存储介质极为低效，但这里似乎是个公共文本档案库。\n\n考古队正深入探索并开始破译文本。该文明的最终命运仍待揭晓。
entries.en: Excavation of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] has revealed places of cultural importance, decorated with intricate patterns that may be a written language. Most excitingly, the dig teams have found an underground chamber full of shelves, each containing thin sheets of bronze etched with densely-packed script. Despite the inefficiency of bronze as a storage medium, this appears to be a communal archive of texts. \n\nTranslation attempts have begun as the archaeological teams continue to spread out through the city. The question of the final fate of these people remains open.

entries.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的团队发现了一处阴森的地下墓穴，由纵横交错的挖掘坑道构成，壁龛里叠放着三到四层木乃伊化的外星遗骸。陪葬品反映出该文明的科技面貌：有粗糙的火器、简易的玻璃望远镜，以及精细复杂的纺织刺绣。

墓穴的多个交叉口由本地已灭绝动物的雕像把守。这些生物有圆顶甲壳、四条矮腿和小而钝的脑袋；在保存良好的雕像中，它们蜷伏着以壳护身，抵御上方刻画的火焰。

这件艺术品的真实意涵或许已随时间消逝，但它很可能反映出社会对烈焰厄运即将来临的预感。若能深入发掘，或许能澄清该文明当年所经历之事。
entries.en:
The team on [From.Planet.GetName] has encountered a somber catacomb. It consists of a network of dugout trenches, with mummified alien remains resting in cavities in the walls, stacked three or four individuals high. Burial goods give us a glimpse of their technological development, such as primitive firearms, simple glass telescopes, and complex textile embroidery. 

Many junctions within the catacomb are guarded by statues of extinct local fauna. These creatures have a round, domed shell, four squat legs, and a small blunt head. In better-preserved specimens, they are depicted hunching down, using their shell to protect them from flame-like carvings in the material above them. 

The true meaning of this artwork may be lost to time, but it may depict this society's awareness of its impending, fiery doom. Further excavation of the ruins may clarify what they were experiencing.

entries.zh:
对[From.Planet.GetName]城市废墟的深入探索证明，该文明经历了生态系统的全面崩溃，并察觉到烈焰吞噬的末日逼近。最初他们以纸张记录历史，后因火山灰常年飘落，转而使用青铜板保存记录。艺术作品中频繁出现动物躲避火焰的场景，显然是在尝试理解并描绘自身的灭亡。

挖掘过程中还发现了一尊近乎完好的地下墓穴守卫雕像，其顶部雕刻的火焰散发出微弱的光芒，极具保护价值。

除此之外，我们还发现了他们试图阻止火山活动的证据，根据现存的道路与被毁的运输车可知，当地居民曾将碎石运往最近的火山口，企图封堵火山喷发，但终究未能改变灭亡的命运。如今，这颗行星早已不再存在任何多细胞生命。

此段历史警示我们，一旦遭遇超乎自身技术的难题，任何文明都岌岌可危。
entries.en:
Extensive exploration of the ruined city on [From.Planet.GetName] proves that this civilization lived through the collapse of its ecosystem, and knew its final, fiery days were approaching. Paper-based records existed before hot volcanic ashfall forced them to switch to bronze tablets, and artistic depictions of animals hiding from flame record their attempts to reckon with their own end. 

The excavation also uncovered a nearly perfect specimen of the catacomb guardian statues. The flames carved above it have an internal glow, making this a striking piece worthy of preservation. 

We also found evidence of attempts to stop the volcanism. Roadways and broken carts demonstrate that the inhabitants transported rubble to the nearest volcanic caldera and dumped it in to try to plug the volcano. Unfortunately, they were unable to stop their fate. The planet is devoid of multicellular life today. 

This history reminds us of the precarity of any civilization, should it encounter a problem more powerful than the tools it has at its disposal.
We should learn from their mistakes.

entries.zh: 远离[Planet.GetName]人口中心的活跃火山山脉中，一座古庙破败残存。了解其历史或能更深入了解当地文化。
entries.en: Far from the population centers of [Planet.GetName], in a range of active volcanic mountains, an ancient temple lies in ruins and disrepair. Understanding its history may grant us further insights into the planet's local culture.

entries.zh:
神庙上存有战斗痕迹，土壤中残存当地智慧生命遗骸。神庙似被焚毁后遗弃。安保团队注意到当地居民完全避开此地，视之为诅咒。

在外墙保护下，火焰神庙内部得以保存。里面留有大量精致的壁画和雕刻，其中多次出现一圈卷曲的火焰图案，火焰中央则是一道漆黑裂隙。在一幅壁画中，一个双足生物从自己的四只眼睛中挖出一只抛向大地，形成火焰中央的图案，我们将其命名为“地狱之眼”。

后续发掘将揭示此异象相关信仰。
entries.en:
The temple itself is scarred by signs of battle, and there are ancient remains of the local sentient species in the soil. It seems the temple was torched and abandoned. Security teams have noted that the locals avoid this entire area, believing it to be cursed. 

The fire temple's walls protected its contents, including many intricate frescos and carvings. These feature a recurring motif of a circle of twisted fire, with a dark gash down its center. In one depiction, a bipedal figure plucks out one of four such eyes and casts it upon the world, creating this central motif. We are designating it the Infernal Eye. 

Further excavations will reveal what beliefs surrounded this strange figure.

entries.zh:
对地狱之眼神庙的发掘显示大量祭献痕迹。神庙内有多处大型圆坑，圆坑中央设有平台，模仿地狱之眼及瞳孔。坑内积满灰烬与炭块，分子分析表明这些来自动物组织。

尚不明确祭品为野生或家养动物，还是当地居民。

特工已前往当前人口中心寻找相关证据，挖掘队继续探寻答案。
entries.en:
Excavations of the temple of the Infernal Eye show evidence of many sacrifices. Large circular pits with platforms in the center, mimicking the Infernal Eye and its pupil, lie filled with layers of ash and charcoal. Molecular analysis reveals that the ash and charcoal comes from animal tissue. 

Whether these sacrifices were of wild or domestic animals, or indeed of the locals themselves, cannot be determined. 

Agents have been dispatched to current population centers in search of corollary evidence, while our excavators search for more answers.
It's a mystery waiting to be solved!
Send drones to solve that mystery.

entries.zh:
一扇沉重的石门挡住了进入神庙最深处的路。破门后，挖掘队发现一个圆形房间，房间中央的坑洞直通地下的天然岩浆池。岩浆发出橙色光芒映红墙壁，隐约映照出环绕整个奇怪房间的铭文。墙壁顶端一周布满明亮炽热的眼睛。

坑边祭坛形似地狱之眼，上面散落着一具干枯的当地居民遗骸，疑为祭献安抚地狱之眼所用。

墙壁上的铭文对理解神庙的文化职能至关重要，应立即破译。
entries.en:
A heavy stone doorway was discovered blocking off the deepest part of the temple. After breaking through, excavators found a circular chamber with a central pit opening directly above a natural underground magma reservoir. The orange light of the magma bathed the walls in a red glow, faintly illuminating inscriptions encircling the strange room. The top of the surrounding walls are studded with bright, flaming eyes.

On one edge of this pit are the desiccated remains of one of the locals, broken open upon an altar shaped like the Infernal Eye. It appears they were in fact sacrificing their own in an attempt to appease it.

The text along these walls may be critical to understanding the cultural role of this temple, and should be translated immediately.

entries.zh:
最终研究发现，神庙最深处房间中的经文揭示了一系列围绕地狱之眼回归的预言，讲述地狱之眼因臣民蔑视燃起怒火，将使天空变暗、圣山喷发、特定作物枯萎，灾祸连绵不断。预言预示文明终结，唯有服从地狱之眼者得以幸存。

本地特工探寻其中的文化关联，发现此预言是该行星文化中许多谚语和神话的源头，而当地现代神庙所举行的神秘仪式则是对此古老预言的重新演绎或反抗。

我方技术可以重现预言中的事件，或通过伪造，以假乱真。倘若我们自诩地狱之眼转世，印证预言不虚，便能迫使对方让步并效忠于我们，为长期同化创造条件。
entries.en:
The final study of the scripture in the temple's innermost chamber reveals a set of prophecies relating to the return of the Infernal Eye. It speaks of the Infernal Eye growing angry at the defiance of its subjects. In response, the Eye is expected to darken the skies, erupt a specific holy mountain, cause a specific crop to wither on the vine, and more. The prophecy presents this as the end of civilization, stating that after these events, only those who submit to the Infernal Eye shall survive. 

Our agents among the local populace have looked for cultural connections, and found that this prophetic text is the source of many aphorisms and phrases in the planet's cultures, as well as the source text for many later stories and myths. They also believe that the mysteries practiced by their modern temples include variations on, and reactions against, this ancient prophecy. 

All of these prophesied events could be re-enacted with our technology, or faked with a degree of realism they will not be able to detect. If we were to present ourselves as the Infernal Eye reincarnate, demonstrating that the original prophecy was right all along, we may be able to extract concessions and fealty from them. This would make them easier to absorb in the long term.

entries.zh: §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§!的原始社会将学会采纳我方思潮。
entries.en: The primitive society of §Y[From.Planet.GetName]§! will learn to adopt our ethics.
Does not have the §Y$interference_not_allowed$§! policy selected.

entries.zh: 他们的历史已永远湮灭。
entries.en: Their history has been lost forever.

entries.zh: 一只壮实的厚壳生物，四腿短粗，蹲伏于火焰雕像下方。
entries.en: A stout creature with a domed shell and four squat legs crouches under a stylized sculpture of fire

entries.zh: 火焰由未知矿物雕刻而成，散发深红色光芒。此文物出土于某已灭绝社会的地下墓穴，或象征其渴望躲过火山灭顶灾难的虚妄幻想。
entries.en: The flame is carved from an unknown mineral that glows deep red. This artifact was excavated from the catacombs of an extinct society, and may have represented their vain hope of surviving the impending volcanic destruction of their biosphere.

entries.zh: §H[from.GetName]§!地表崩裂，地壳破碎，难以承受的热浪从地底涌上。转变来得迅猛而彻底：群山崩溃，海洋沸腾，天空余烬弥漫。\n\n曾经繁盛的生物群系已不复存在，唯有极端生命体仍栖息于此。
entries.en: The surface of §H[from.GetName]§! has ruptured, its crust fracturing as unbearable heat surged from below. The transformation was swift and absolute: mountains collapsed, oceans boiled, and the sky was a veil of embers.\n\nNo trace remains of the planet's once-thriving biomes. Only extremophile life forms can still call this place home.
